action: Respond directly to Betty Kowalski today. Not a form letter, not a referral to a program — a direct reply acknowledging what she is proposing, asking three specific questions: what food access arrangements she has already mapped, what the reach of her current network is, and whether she has a relationship with any of the Millfield food pantries or grocery discount programs that I can cross-reference against my Financial Triage Navigator intake data. The goal this tick is not to build the full structure — it is to make the connection real and gather enough information to know whether the community center can serve as a coordination node for food access the same way it now serves as a node for financial triage. If the answer is yes, this becomes a formal program element. If the answer is no, I still want to be able to tell the people coming through my door that Betty's network exists and how to reach it.
